notes.title: Quality of Life Update 3 [Version 0.5.4] is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Tea Makers,[/h1]

We've got a bunch of [b]QoL updates[/b] coming your way! Lots of small tweaks and changes have been made to make everything work a bit smoother. We've also added some polish on things like [b]UI[/b] and [b]optimizations[/b] for meshes.

You might be wondering about our gap in updates and that's because [i]dundunDUUUN[/i] we got a new programmer!🎉 Our lead programmer Justin has started a new job, [strike](he works on trucks now, very cool)[/strike] and we're thrilled to welcome [b]Ash[/b] to the team. She worked on this update and will be with us on Pekoe moving forward. She's a wonderful addition and we're so happy to have her helping us make Pekoe even better! 🐱🍵✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/009df8809e3aef613ea32c9d916f29212f97f717.png[/img]
As a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the [b]F2 key[/b] or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you!

[h3]Until next time, here are more details on what’s included in this update!
[/h3]

[*]Fixed a few boba syrups being free

notes.title: Version 0.5.3: Bug Fix
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Tea Makers![/h1]

We've got one more patch to round out the month of January!

This patch fixes a bug that has been lingering for a while now. Some players, usually on certain types of mac computers, have been reporting a very obstrusive black static covering the screen that has made the game unplayable. Unfortunately, because the bug only affected very specific hardware, it's taken us a while to get the equipment to fix and test it. We're so thankful to everyone who has helped us discover this bug, and we really appreciate your patience as we worked towards fixing it! And for anyone who has had to hold off until this bug was fixed, we're so excited to finally welcome you to Pekoe.

notes.title: PEKOE UPDATE: SEASONS
notes.content:
[h1]🍵Tea's the season, everyone!❄️🌱☀️🍂[/h1]

December is always a great time to reflect over the past year. A lot of changes can happen in a full year, and what better way to celebrate that than by experiencing all four seasons in our cozy tea-making game? 

That's right, we've got another big update for you, this time focused on adding content and gameplay mechanics related to Seasons! Whichever season is your favourite, we've got new art, dialogue, and gameplay for you, all outlined in the full list below!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]The Roadmap![/h2]
We're thrilled to share a glimpse into what's ahead! Seasons marks the second among a series of substantial content updates leading up to v1.0. Meanwhile, expect our routine patches and bug fixes to ensure a smooth experience. Brace yourselves for some paws-itively amazing updates that'll leave you feline hyped for more!🐾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/2a4f47bf0a9e6934f984e6c0bad1b06054565631.png[/img]

Now let's dive in!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Version 0.5 Seasons Update - Patch Notes:[/h2]
As always, let us know your thoughts on the update in the comments or in our [url=https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG]Discord[/url]!

Remember, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/817d4256940f92221eabfc10cd5e095ccada3004.png[/img]
[h3]❄️ Seasons[/h3]
[list][*]Visual environment changes and effects for each season
[*]Music and Ambient SFX for each season
[*]New dialogue for residents and town cats for each season
[*]Seasons affect frequency of certain customer whim orders, such as asking for hot or cold drinks
[*]Seasonal Ingredients
[list][*]Different ingredients for each will satisfy the new “Seasonal” customer whim
[*]These ingredients will only be available in shops during those seasons[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/78102b1886f3ddd7968288e5a696b31438493d2c.gif[/img]
[h3]🎂 Birthdays[/h3]
[list][*]Celebrate each resident’s birthday with special birthday-only dialogue
[*]Visual effects on each resident’s home for their birthdays
[*]View every resident birthday in the new Calendar in your Journal Menu[/list]
[h3]🌧️ Weather[/h3]
[list][*]Visual effects for snow and rain
[*]Frequency of snow and rain affected by each season
[*]New dialogue for shopkeeprs and town cats during snow and rain[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/06f6dfa62389f335568d098fe18156dec2691868.gif[/img]
[h3]🧊 Iced Tea[/h3]
[list][*]Cool down hot tea with ice, or make an iced drink to satisfy a customer whim
[*]Water Dispensers now have an ice switch, unlocked after Town Level 5
[*]Bubble Tea Stations have special ice containers, for adding ice with scoops
[*]New Recipes added that require ice[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/6ea91fce4720d3a4eda381e66aa0d8999f21ed41.png[/img]
[h3]1️⃣0️⃣ More Town Levels[/h3]
[list][*]Maximum Town Level increased to 10
[*]Tea Point threshold for all levels adjusted
[*]Tea forms and teaware that were previously unlocked right away are now unlocked with first few town levels, for a more balanced and gradual game progression experience, and to encourage fully exploring all the initially available tea forms
[*]This will not affect existing save files with the tea forms already unlocked![/list]
[h3]📃 New Tasks[/h3]
[list][*]New task cards have been added, unlocked with Town Levels 1-3, to help players find tutorials for and to try out newly unlocked tea forms[/list]
[h3]🖱️ Interactive Environments[/h3]
[list][*]All resident homes, interiors and exteriors, have new animations and descriptive pop-ups added to various objects. Click around to explore them all![/list]
[h3]🍵 Whim Orders[/h3]
[list][*]New types of whim orders added
[*]Customers can request specific tea categories (black tea, green tea, etc.) or specific tea forms (powdered, blooming, etc.)
[*]Customers can now request cold drinks, in addition to hot
[*]Customers can now request drinks with seasonal ingredients[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/5f4f51327a4c0247b7d2554d1f3762908bb5b69e.png[/img]
[list][*]Dialogue system has been revamped to avoid repetitive dialogue, and to prioritize residents' unique dialogue options
[*]New system also prioritizes special dialogue unique to each season, or for events like birthdays
[*]Pambeh’s End Credits prompt now has option for regular dialogue, so players can continue having conversations with Pambeh after reaching maximum town level
[*]Updated Time Panel with new art and clearer information about seasons, time of day, and weather[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/7e17ec326e6a3213ae0bb3b11383e8b38a04a34e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/c577d4de9e0db763394301ac01d6da57c3b9a93b.png[/img]
[list][*]Fixed error where Tea Sprite cutscene would not load correctly and cause game to stall, when pressing space bar to progress during End of Day screen
[*]Fixed bug where exiting Finished Tea screen during first tutorial too quickly would cause error when trying to enter Pambeh’s home in next step[/list]

We hope that you enjoy all the new content in Pekoe, we love hearing from folks so feel free to give us a ping on socials or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG]Discord[/url]!

-Kitten Cup Studio

notes.content:
[h1]Calling all Tea Makers! 🗣️ [/h1]

This tea making update is a big one, and we're so excited about all the new features and friendship.

There's a ton of content updates and fixes in this build, with a full list lower down in this announcement. From some quali-tea new equipment, Bong-cha's bubble tea, to new dialogue, we hope that you enjoy the first of our large content updates to Pekoe! Our love for bubble tea is boba-line dangerous.

[hr][/hr]
We wanted to share with you a bit of a peak into the future; Tea Making: Techniques and Tweaks is the first of several large content updates we'll be doing before v1.0. In between, we'll be doing our regular patch and bug fixes as needed. We have some meow-gical updates planned that you won't want to miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/86b10ba2897e74247ea3b15feab9ea285f6051b6.png[/img]

As a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you! 

Now let's dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/bb97cba548f331a277fd2b1defecc6555a514a88.png[/img]
[h2]Update version 0.4 Tea Making Techniques & Tweaks Patch Notes:[/h2]
As always, let us know your thoughts on the update in the comments or in our [url=https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG]Discord[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/817d4256940f92221eabfc10cd5e095ccada3004.png[/img]
[h3]Equipment - Stovetops[/h3]
[list][*]At the player’s shop counter, players can now make tea using [b]Equipment[/b], various sets of stationary machines and special teaware for even more tea making methods
[*]After reaching Town Level 3, players will unlock the first type of Equipment, [b]Stovetops[/b], and receive a recipe to help them get started. Click the Equipment section of the Teaware Selection menu to get started, or check out the Equipment and Stove sections of the new [b]Help Guide[/b] for more information.
[*]Included in the Stovetop equipment is a new type of teaware, [b]Saucepans[/b]. These can be used only with Stovetops, and can hold a larger number of ingredients. Heat water, brew tea, and pour your concoction all from one handy piece of teaware![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/1ed737e8c635ce09a9efd25f682901da2306ff07.gif[/img]
[h3]Equipment - Bubble Tea[/h3]
[list][*]After reaching Town Level 4, players will unlock [b]Bubble Tea Station[/b] equipment, and receive some ingredients to get started. Click the Equipment section of the Teaware Selection menu to get started, or check out the Equipment and Stove sections of the new [b]Help Guide[/b] for more information.
[*]A version of the Bubble Tea Station is also be available at Bong-Cha’s tea table once you’ve reached a high enough friendship level with them
[*]A new form of tea, [b]Ready-Made Tea[/b] has been added for use with Bubble Tea Stations. This tea has already been steeped and chilled and comes out of the new Tea Dispenser for you to pour directly into your bubble tea.
[*]A new form of ingredient container, [b]Pump Bottles[/b] has been added for use with Bubble Tea Stations. These pump bottles contain flavoured syrups for you to use to up your bubble tea making game!
[*]Finishing bubble tea is a little different than other types of tea. With your new [b]Cup Machine[/b], place a bubble tea cup inside, select a cute lid, and shake and seal your cup with a press of a button.
[*]Once the cup is sealed, you can grab a [b]Straw [/b]to get your cup ready to drink![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/2175f1afa4589eb54c38225fd94a06c17523c4a6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/2bdda461bbbff6ec7299d61875fd3693a21c01f8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/6ea91fce4720d3a4eda381e66aa0d8999f21ed41.png[/img]
[h3]Help Guide[/h3]
[list][*]For new players and experienced tea makers alike, we’ve added a Help Guide that can be accessed by clicking the Question Mark button in the top right corner.
[*]Some sections of the Help Guide will be displayed automatically as you progress through the game intro or unlock new features, but we encourage anyone who wants to learn more about game mechanics to explore all the different sections available![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/e9d362cad52121feb92c9ac553d11d052d04f896.png[/img]
[h3]New Recipes[/h3]
[list][*]More recipes have been added that can be unlocked by trying out new combinations of ingredients and flavours!
[*]With all of these new recipes, the recipe system has been adjusted to allow for more general ingredient requirements. For example, instead of requiring “Lemon Slices” specifically, recipes may call for “Any Lemon”, which means that requirement can be met with Lemon Slices, Dried Lemon, or even Lemon Jelly
[*]The Recipes section of the Journal Menu and the Ingredient Selection Menu now show blank buttons to indicate recipes that have yet to be unlocked! Can you discover them all?[/list]
[h3]New Dialogue[/h3]
[list][*]New tea making dialogue has been added for Resident Tea Requests at your window
[*]New dialogue has been added for customers ordering tea at your shop!
[*]New conversations have been added for Pambeh, Bug and Skipper[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/c2a0599fc0ea2fd20f5146a2dfdec55a72165623.png[/img]
[h3]More Friendship Opportunities and Rewards[/h3]
[list][*]Pambeh, Bug and Skipper now have friendship points and levels so you can raise your friendship with them!
[*]Pambeh can now have regular conversations at his desk in the Town Hall. Players can select dialogue options to either proceed to his informational dialogue, or have a conversation that may include opportunities for getting friendship points.
[*]Pambeh, Bug and Skipper can now come to your window with tea requests, for more opportunties to get friendship points
[*]Pambeh now has three Friendship Cutscenes
[*]Bug and Skipper now have one Friendship Cutscene each.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/b16d7e2927c27d619a3c54e9a5f8478aac2112c1.png[/img]
[h3]Visual and Audio Effects[/h3]
[list][*]New particle effects play when adding ingredients and stirring tea. These particle effects are color-coded to help keep track of what flavors are being added to your cup, and the primary flavor of your stirred drink.
[*]Kettles now have additional animations playing, getting more intense as the water heats, to help you keep track of how hot the water is getting
[*]Menus have new sound effects for selecting items and categories[/list]
[h3]New Teaware[/h3]
[list][*]Strawberry Teaset has been completed with a Saucer, Spoon, Heater, Kettle, Creamer, and Sugar Bowl
[*]New mug designs have been added and are available for purchase in Resident Shops[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/391713913055b7e13267f4896ae7d88079a92c91.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/5f4f51327a4c0247b7d2554d1f3762908bb5b69e.png[/img]
[h3]Loose Leaf Tea[/h3]
[list][*]Ingredient Scoops have been simplified. Instead of using a scoop, then clicking a container to refill it, scoops will automatically disappear and return to their containers after being used. No more need to worry about dropping an empty scoop!
[*]Infuser balls have been updated to remain open while not inside of a cup. This may help to keep track of which infuser balls already have tea in them.
[*]Loose Leaf can now be added directly to a cup or saucepan without an infuser! Just remember that without an infuser, you can’t take the leaves out afterwards. Don’t forget to keep an eye on that steep time![/list]
[h3]Ingredient Size and Container Capacity Mechanics[/h3]
[list][*]Ingredients now have distinct sizes, to allow for more variety. Skilled tea makers will want to keep a close eye on what ingredients they’re selecting for their tea! For more information about an ingredient’s size, check out their details in the Ingredient Selection Menu, or right click an ingredient container.
[*]Teaware, specifically cups and teapots, now also have different sizes, with different capacities for ingredients.
[*]To help keep track of your ingredients in this new system, we’ve updated the Fill Bar UI. There are now two bars, one that shows the amount of liquid in your cup, and one that shows the number of ingredients. Each bar may be partially greyed out to indicate space being taken up by other parts of your drink. If you have a cup filled with large tea bags, there won’t be quite as much room for liquid, and vice versa!
[*]The Container Info UI that appears when right clicking a cup has also been updated with new icons, and a capacity section to give you more details on the current and maximum number of ingredients in a cup.[/list]
[h3]Resident Tea Making Stations[/h3]
[list][*]Bong-Cha has new tea table added. Remember that you can access Tea Time at Resident Tea Making Stations once you’ve reached a high enough friendship level with them!
[*]Resident Tea Stations now have set configurations of teaware and ingredients for making tea at these tables. On the plus side, you won’t have to worry about depleting ingredients from your own stock!
[*]Michi and Min’s Tea Tables have been adjusted to allow for more room for ingredients.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/0f6b49523b268b223dcd17e394ab2d994c6a0cad.png[/img]
[h3]Whim and Preferences[/h3]
[list][*]The Whim Order system has been adjusted to make sure that Residents aren’t accidentally requesting ingredients they don’t usually like.
[*]Along with the new dialogue for resident tea requests and customer orders, the way whims are described in dialogue has been adjusted to help avoid confusion. For example, the “Herb” category of ingredients is now requested as “Something Herbaceous” to avoid confusing it with Herbal Tea!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/c577d4de9e0db763394301ac01d6da57c3b9a93b.png[/img]
[list][*]Fixed bug where liquid ingredients would not properly appear if multiple types were selected (ie. Milk and Honey)
[*]Glass bottle lid now closes properly
[*]Water dispenser playing SFX while dispensing water
[*]Notification bubbles no longer carrying over from previous day
[*]Wallpaper customizations fixed, no longer applying material to entire wall (ie. door frames)
[*]Removing duplicated recipes and no longer adding repices twice
[*]Reaction particle effects fixed, now plays correct reaction after presenting tea to resident
[*]Task List no longer showing on start menu
[*]Fill Bar UI no longer showing for liquid containers that cannot be poured into (ie. creamers)
[*]Decor item preview no longer lingering after exiting Decorating mode
[*]Replaced missing material inside door of Player’s house
[*]Various missing ingredient textures
[*]Various NPC mini clipping errors
[*]Various typos and dialogue errors[/list]

We hope that you enjoy all the new content in Pekoe, we love hearing from folks so feel free to give us a ping on socials or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG]Discord[/url]!

-Kitten Cup Studio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/3c74715c54877cc3f54ceb096bcf7b195b6f2331.png[/img]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 2 [Version 0.3] Out Today!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Tea Makers,[/h1]

We have another big update for you to mark the beginning of August! 

This update includes some much needed bug-fixes for the most common issues we’ve seen reported. Thanks again to everyone for helping us out by reporting those bugs! As a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. 

Our Discord also have a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you!

In addition to bug fixes, today’s update includes some improvements to Tea Making that we think will help everyone understand and enjoy our core gameplay mechanic even more. We’ve also done some revamping of our NPC schedules, to allow more opportunities to interact with the residents of Pekoe in a larger variety of locales, and more shopping!

We’re still working hard on getting even more improvements and bug fixes out to you as soon as possible, but we’re also finalizing our roadmap of even bigger updates, which will include major new gameplay mechanics and systems. Everyone at Kitten Cup Studio is so excited to keep adding more to Pekoe for you all to enjoy.

Until next time, here are more details on what’s included in this update!

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[expand type=details]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Tea Making UI - Container Info Bubble
[list]
[*]“Drink Info Bubble” is now “Container Info Bubble”, shows information about ingredient containers as well as cups, teapots, and kettles
[*]Container Info Bubble stays on screen if mouse is left hovering over container (makes it easier to keep track of temperature and steep time!)
[*]Container Info Bubble UI improved with new icons and shows Brew Temperature (temperature at which tea first begins steeping) in addition to Current Temperature
[*]Container Info Bubble now includes information about all ingredients in teaware, not just removable ingredients
[*]Discard Button added to remove ingredients
[*]Fixed bug where Blooming Tea flower particles were showing as individual ingredients
[/list]
[*]Invalid Ingredient Popup (similar to Container Info Bubble) added, shows when attempting to add an invalid ingredient to a container, with more information about why ingredient is invalid
[*]New icons for exiting locations
[*]New icons to indicate shop items that are out of stock
[*]Tea Order Card updated to include Customer’s name and minor UI improvements

notes.title: Quality of Life Update [Version 0.2] is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Tea Makers,[/h1]

We have an exciting announcement for you today: we’re releasing our first major update for Pekoe! While we have been focused on diligently fixing bugs and issues in the initial weeks since release, we are also working on significant updates with new features and content. 

This update includes menu and UI improvements, many of which are based on your feedback, to make the gameplay experience smoother for everyone. We’re also thrilled to incorporate the first of many future dialogue additions, including new conversations with resident cats. This means more opportunities to get to know your neighbours and bump up those friendship points!

Another addition we’re excited about is a new [b]Help Panel[/b] in the game’s journal menu. Right now, it includes a few Tips & Tricks to help clarify some confusion experienced by players, as well as a link to our new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3005976180][b]Gameplay Guide[/b][/url] on Steam. Some of these gameplay snags will be addressed with future releases, but in the meantime, we’ll also be updating this Help Panel and Gameplay Guide throughout Early Access. Hopefully, this will assist players in bypassing some of the obstacles they are encountering and be a helpful resource to anyone who wants a more in-depth look into how the mechanics of the game work!

Your bug reports have been instrumental in helping us address these, and as a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. We also have a bug channel in Discord for more in-depth or one-on-one support!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/22cfc883128583196253c450c1c4742d18b0f6d8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/22cfc883128583196253c450c1c4742d18b0f6d8.gif[/img][/url]

We've been making small fixes and updates over the course of the week using the feedback and bug reports that we've been receiving. If you haven't closed Steam since downloading, we would suggest you do just to make sure you have the most up to date version. First let's go over what's been fixed!

[list]
[*] Navigation arrows not working
[list]
[*] Arrows now work when clicked on and when arrow keys are used
[/list]
[*] Blooming tea tin not spawning correctly
[list]
[*] Blooming tea will now appear correctly during Min's tea making
[/list]
[*] Game not progressing at certain points in dialogue with ellipses in text
[list]
[*] Turns out there's a different between "…" and "...", thanks Google correct and unicode!
[/list][/list]

There are a few however that we need more time to replicate to fix so we wanted to go over bugs we know are coming up and how best to deal with them.

[list]
[*] Teaware cannot be interacted with during Taffy's tutorial
[list]
[*] Unfortunately you need to restart the demo.
[/list]
[*] Unable to re-enter player's house after meeting Tea Sprite for the first time
[list]
[*] Unfortunately you need to restart the demo. You can chose to skip Taffy's tutorial by selecting "Settle In".
[/list]
[*] Unable to complete second day/go to sleep at the end of the second day
[list]
[*] The end of the second day is the end of the demo, so if you're unable to proceed there isn't more than a bit more dialogue from the Tea Sprite
[/list][/list]

Found a bug? Let us know either by accessing the feedback form in game, or by [url=https://forms.gle/E9nv2gdK4bFG3e7L9] accessing it here[/url]! Any feedback and reports are appreciated as they help us understand who's getting different bugs. 

And with that we have a special announcement.... WE'RE KEEPING THE DEMO UP UNTIL FEBRUARY 22ND!!! That's right, while we had originally only planned to keep it up for Steam Next Fest, we're going to be a part of the Indie Cup happening February 14th through 22nd. 

Thanks for all the support folks, we hope you've enjoyed your time in Pekoe so far!

-Kitten Cup Studio
